files.title: 2020 Barranquilla - Iglesia de San Nicolas de Tolentino (Barranquilla)
files.author: Felipe Restrepo Acosta

notes: Neogothic parish church in barrio San Nicolás (centro), pink-and-cream with twin towers. photo-1: three-quarter view from the plaza showing the west front plus part of the south flank, both clock towers and sculptural gable detail (some people/festival flags in foreground). photo-2: straight-on frontal view of the full west facade under blue sky — cleanest elevation reference. Interior shots also exist on Commons if needed later.
